newsitems.title: Breach Midseason Designer’s Notes
newsitems.author: respawn_bean
newsitems.contents: [h2][b]TLDR;[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Below, we will share insights into our goals for each Legend or Weapon, challenges we’ve identified, and what changes we are making in pursuit of those goals.[/p][list][*][p]Crushing the Peak of Dominant Team Comps[/p][/*][*][p]Gibraltar’s Speed Boost and Electrified Dome[/p][/*][*][p]Wraith’s Lowered Cooldowns and Enhanced Ult[/p][/*][*][p]Watson’s Hardlight Auto-Reinforce[/p][/*][*][p]Say Hello to a Brand NEW Hemlok Breach AR[/p][/*][*][p]The Future of the RE-45 Burst [/p][/*][*][p]State of the 30-30 Repeater, P2020 and Prowler[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]INTRODUCTION[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Welcome to Designer’s Notes for the mid-season split for Breach! We appreciate all the time you’ve put into the season so far, and we’re grateful for all the feedback. With your feedback and our internal match data, we have been tuning and adjusting to find the balance sweet spot. Your feedback helped inform [u][url="https://x.com/ApexLiveComms/status/2026102651662827797"]changes to Octane[/url][/u] and the [u][url="https://x.com/ApexLiveComms/status/2023936811874025935"]Ranked Drop Zones system[/url][/u], and we will continue to monitor these elements. We also tuned up Fuse a bit and are continuing to aim for him to deliver that offensive breacher experience. For this next split we are focused on our looking to punch up some Legends, lean into the breach gameplay, and bring a unique twist to the Hemlok. [/p][p align="start"]Our aim with this blog is to provide ongoing transparency and reasoning for [i]why[/i] we are making the balancing decisions with each update. We want you to head into your matches with this knowledge, discuss how the changes are landing, and let us know what is working and what is not. Your continued feedback is important in helping us tune Apex and make the best competitive Battle Royale it can be![/p][h2][b]CRUSHING THE PEAK OF DOMINANT TEAM COMPS[/b][/h2][p align="start"]As we reach the midway point of the first season of 2026, we want to take a moment to introduce you to a specific indicator of game health: Legend squad composition. A healthy state for Legends is one where people feel many different team compositions are viable. Over the last year we have made a deliberate effort to squash the dominance of top-picked squad combinations to encourage creative player expression, or to allow you to play the way you are most comfortable and not feel like there’s one specific trio of characters that is ‘must-pick’. [/p][p align="start"]We measure this by looking at the 10 most popular team compositions and evaluating how much market share they occupy; we pursue a lower percentage/concentration from the most popular compositions, as it indicates greater legend diversity. When we see a rising percentage occupied by a handful of team compositions it indicates to us that the Legend meta has tilted towards a ‘must pick’ squad or Legend combo. [/p][p align="start"]We had a moment late last year where Sparrow and Ash were ripping up the Ranked charts. Anchored by that specific pair of Legends, our top 10 most popular squad compositions represented 25% of all squads in Ranked Apex. If you look at the period just before and after, there was a similar concentration of the top 10 squad compositions representing around 20% of all teams, which was still higher than we deemed healthy.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/4Nf4c2yj3PsnVjuf6uOjC3/9ad60710ffcc251d5eac6e4b524487a4/01_Ranked_Team_Comp_Concentration_-_1_Year_Historical_View.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.48854166666666665,yPosition=0.47962962962962963"][/img][/p][p align="start"]As you can see in the chart above, over the last 12 months, through a series of impactful reworks, buffs and nerfs, we have seen the concentration of the top 10, 5 and 1 squad compositions drop dramatically. Reworked characters like Ash, Valkyrie and Octane have each had their ‘moment’ of being high pick rate, but we are happy to see the presence of a ‘must pick’ duo or trio in Apex has all but disappeared over the last 12 months.[/p][h2][b]LEGENDS[/b][/h2][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/1l2QG76iSo55rKV0DTmCqZ/895b3ef51d9fea676135ae19f0ec63de/02_Legend_Pick_Rate_and_Encounter_Win_Rate.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.6627604166666666,yPosition=0.4287037037037037"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]2026-02-24 through 2026-03-02[/i][/p][h3][b]GIBRALTAR[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Gibraltar has been sitting close to the bottom of the Legend pick rates across all ranks and skill levels for quite a while. We still feel like he has a strong kit but it’s been difficult for Gibraltar to find success, as newer Legends or recent buffs have made it easier to push into his Dome of Protection. [/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/1KjynVnhRXyx0EPLB0jJso/a21aeb070f9c32774f6c8cbf698e087b/03_Overall_Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Gibraltar.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Some of the biggest pain points we are seeing about Gibraltar are that he's big and slow and the dome is too easy to push into, especially with higher mobility Legends. [/p][p align="start"]Gibraltar’s size isn’t something we can change but we did want to tackle the feeling of him being slow. For this we’re adding a momentum passive to help him get around faster while out of combat. It requires him to build up to max unarmed sprint speed and then maintain it for a couple seconds to gain a speed boost. It also gives him some nice synergies with his Fast Shotties upgrade allowing him to activate that speed boost while he has a shotgun out. [/p][p align="start"]One thing that has been frustrating with Gibraltar was that his ultimate had a delay before you could throw it - it could make it feel unresponsive and it functions differently from other Legends. We are improving that execution time and so players won’t feel stuck when throwing his ultimate. [/p][p align="start"]We wanted to take Gibraltar’s upgrades beyond simple stat increases. To achieve this we’ve added three new upgrades and integrated the larger radius ultimate and faster cooldowns into the base kit. [/p][p align="start"][b]New Upgrades[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Thunder Dome[/b] will electrify the dome of protection. This will make it so the first enemy to enter the dome will take damage and be slowed for a short time. This should give the players in the dome some added protection and will make enemies think twice before pushing in. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Healing Dome[/b] will allow players to get double healing for small meds while in the healing dome. This will also increase the duration of the dome allowing for more healing. This is a great reset tool, giving Gibraltar and his teammates time to quickly recover.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Triple Bombardment[/b] will split Defensive bombardment into three charges but with a smaller radius and fewer missiles. This will give players a bit more flexibility on placement and cover different angles versus the single charge version. [/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We think these new upgrades are going to give some extra defense or reset potential depending on your preferred playstyle. [/p][h3][b]WRAITH[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Wraith has been on a slow decline in pick rate over the years. While she’s always been a popular legend she’s starting to get overshadowed by other Skirmishers. We wanted to find ways to give Wraith some more team utility while also adding some quality of life updates to her base kit.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/1RStCjkB6ySEeG6tkIjwmx/24e260a3ce425c99c1be9a2d962232d4/04_All_Time_Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Wraith.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The feedback we’re hearing about Wraith is mainly that she’s feeling outdated and isn’t offering enough with her ultimate. Also that the ultimate cast time is too slow. [/p][p align="start"]To address these concerns, we’ll be integrating the two cooldown upgrades into her base kit and replacing them with two new upgrades; she’ll now have access to her abilities more often. We’re also speeding up the cast time for her ultimate, making her less vulnerable during that initial wind up. [/p][p align="start"][b]New Upgrades[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Phase Dome[/b] upgrade will create a dome when Wraith starts channeling her ultimate. Anyone who enters the dome will go into the void, making them invulnerable just like when Wraith uses her tactical. The goal with this is to offer Wraith's teammates a safe place to wait while she’s getting ready to place her portal. Once the portal is placed the dome will end, players will leave the void and be able to enter into Wraith's ultimate portal. The phase dome does have a timeout since Wraith’s channel time is based on distance. We didn’t want to encourage Wraith hiding in a corner while their team got to stay safe in the void. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Phase Jumper[/b] will extend the duration of Wraith’s tactical ability. She will stay in the void for a longer time. She will also gain the ability to double jump while in the void. This upgrade should give Wraith some extra options for escape and traversal. [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]WATTSON[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Wattson has had a pretty flat pick rate despite a bit of an uptick during her last set off buffs. While she is still a strong Controller and offers great area management, we wanted to give her some small buffs and add synergies with Hardlight Meshes.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/3tiw5Z81i0kyMoT5A7JaLq/011319e5d99aa7b754063dd8536edb92/05_Overall_Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Wattson.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Some of the pain points we are looking to address are the speed of deployment of her tactical and of its effectiveness. For this we’ve sped up the deployment to be much faster and we’ve increased the damage when getting hit by her fences. [/p][p align="start"]With the new Hardlight Meshes this season we want our Controllers to have some advantages when fighting around them. Wattson already wants to take control of a room so we’ve given her tools to quickly reinforce Hardlight. [/p][p align="start"]By placing her tactical in front of a Hardlight Mesh it will be instantly reinforced. This will rebuild [i]and[/i] reinforce broken Hardlight also. If an already reinforced mesh breaks while a fence is in front of it, the mesh will rebuild and reinforce after a short cooldown. [/p][p align="start"]When placing her ultimate a pulse will be released that will reinforce all Hardlight meshes and rebuild broken Hardlight within the radius of the Interception Pylon. Similar to the tactical, if a mesh breaks that was reinforced by the Pylon it will rebuild and reinforce after a short cooldown. [/p][p align="start"]With these new reinforcing capabilities Wattson is going to be able to really lockdown a room with Hardlight.[/p][h2][b]WEAPONS[/b][/h2][h3][b]HEMLOK BREACH AR - NEWEST ELITE WEAPON[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The Hemlok Breach AR is the first ever fully automatic silenced weapon in Apex Legends. It also comes with a secondary fire mode that launches an explosive Breach Charge, dealing extra damage to Hardlight and placeable Legend abilities.[/p][p align="start"]We’ve always wanted to add a silencer in Apex Legends as it's an exciting weapon mechanic that we haven't truly explored and adds tactical depth. However, adding one to existing weapons has proved to be a challenge, as doing so could change their core feel. Recently, the Elite Weapon design space, has provided a unique opportunity to experiment and we feel it’s the right spot to introduce the Hemlok Breach AR. [/p][p align="start"]With Hardlight allowing controllers to lock down areas we wanted to provide players with exciting new tools to break into those bunkers. Building an elite weapon to fulfill this fantasy was an exciting opportunity because we could be a little more explosive with our ideas.[/p][h3][b]RE-45 BURST[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The RE-45 Burst will be permanently replacing the RE-45 Auto in loot pools![/p][p align="start"]We had long discussions and evaluated match data trying to decide if we can reasonably replace the RE-45 Auto, but ultimately we feel the RE-45 Burst is a much more exciting version of the weapon with a more defined identity. In its energy form, it no longer competes in a saturated design space with other high fire rate, automatic, light ammo weapons and helps create more diversity in the weapon roster.[/p][h3][b]MARSKMAN WEAPONS[/b][/h3][p align="start"]If you’ve been following along for any length of time, you know that we’ve been working to shift away from a long-range, Marksman-dominated meta to more close quarters combat. We’re happy to report that we’re seeing Marksman weapon dominance finally coming down and the viability of other weapon types rebounding as a result.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/6GcaW3OyvVN4hGnp3UOx6L/319d7b8ce840c65ce419fee800ea9032/06_Weapon_Share_of_Downs_and_Encounter_Win_Rate_-_Marksman_Rifles.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.4856770833333333,yPosition=0.4847222222222222"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]2026-02-24 through 2026-03-02[/i][/p][p align="start"]That said, we have noticed the 30-30 Repeater lagging behind other weapons in its class so we are reverting a previous nerf to base damage.[/p][list][*][p]30-30 Repeater base damage: 41 → 43[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]SHOTGUNS[/b][/h3][p align="start"]After our recent round of buffs to shotguns, we have seen some encouraging upward progress to their encounter win rate.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5u7ftVOhc3smcLOIoE1Y76/9724666501bebab185c9948bbd3c8902/07_Weapon_Share_of_Downs_and_Encounter_Win_Rate_-_Shotguns.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.27421875,yPosition=0.5611111111111111"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]2026-02-24 through 2026-03-02[/i][/p][p align="start"]While we’re happy with this progress, they still remain relatively low on the graph compared to the rest of the weapons. Because we know that a meta dominated by shotgun strength and popularity can lead to a lot of player frustration, we are going to proceed cautiously and continue to monitor the situation.[/p][p align="start"]That being said, the EVA-8 is receiving a small buff to increase its reload speed.[/p][h3][b]P2020 AND PROWLER[/b][/h3][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/smiSg4ehnLc25qc8UbKg5/4ae2170121ed7b8cde5d815f42028323/08_Weapon_Share_of_Downs_and_Encounter_Win_Rate_-_Pistol___SMGs.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5541666666666667,yPosition=0.5"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]2026-02-24 through 2026-03-02[/i][/p][p align="start"]Compared to their respective weapon classes, the P2020 and Prowler are lagging behind slightly, so we’re giving them both a bit of a tune up![/p][list][*][p]P2020 magazine: \[8 → 9][/p][/*][*][p]P2020 points to unlock Hammerpoint Rounds: \[500 → 425][/p][/*][*][p]Prowler burst fire delay reduced[/p][/*][*][p]Prowler’s recoil reduced[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]CONCLUSION[/b][/h2][p align="start"]We hope these Designer’s Notes have helped provide meaningful insight into the dev team’s decision making processes for the balance changes in the second half of Breach. For a full change log of everything happening in Apex Legends, be sure to check out the [url="https://www.ea.com/games/apex-legends/apex-legends/news/aftershock-event"]Patch Notes[/url], available now![/p]

newsitems.title: Aftershock Event + Midseason Patch Notes
newsitems.author: respawn_bean
newsitems.contents:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="DGnH8MfyTf0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

Get amped up for high-voltage combat in the Aftershock Event, running from Mar 31 to Apr 21.[/p][p align="start"]Wildcard gets a power surge with the Vortex Shield and 9 new Wild Cards, fresh Legend Updates for Gibby, Wraith, and Wattson, plus a new Elite Hemlok, Fuse Prestige Skin, and more. Nice.[/p][p align="start"]Get all the details and latest changes below in the Patch Notes.[/p][p align="start"]Ready? Let’s charge in.[/p][h2][b]WILDCARD: CHARGED UP[/b][/h2][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/3rFGgDxJsQ6ZSvk5YLnwcE/72728da7e034cdae39e0ccc4685e0563/APEX_Legends_S28_Screenshots_ChargedUpBPSplit_VortexShield_A_v03.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.47994791666666664,yPosition=0.47453703703703703"][/img][/p][p align="start"]This new Wildcard is all about POWER. (And the anxiety of realizing your battery’s about to die.)[/p][p align="start"]Every Legend is now equipped with a Vortex Shield: raise the Vortex Shield to catch incoming bullets, then release to fire them back at enemies. But keep an eye on your shield’s energy! Recharge your shield by collecting EVO.[/p][p align="start"]Getting rushed? Unleash the power of the EMP Blast to stun enemies and damage placeable objects. Then recharge your EMP Battery by blocking damage with the Vortex Shield, collecting EVO, or with new Wild Cards.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/7huFQQJn2nYcTiLUM8M55j/e5acb32d5c5e986b4f92fac28c2cb97c/APEX_Legends_S28_Screenshots_ChargedUpBPSplit_WildCard_B_v03.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.2713541666666667,yPosition=0.4439814814814815"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Supercharge your arsenal with nine electric new Wild Cards:[/p][list][*][p][b]Bigger and Better[/b]: Greatly increases the size of the Vortex Shield, speeds up deploy and stow time[/p][/*][*][p][b]Duck and Cover:[/b] Increases the Vortex Shield’s protective area but disables return fire[/p][/*][*][p][b]Energy Efficient:[/b] EMP Blast costs 50% energy (two uses per charge)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sonic Boom:[/b] Upgrades the EMP Blast damage and adds knockback[/p][/*][*][p][b]Static Charge:[/b] EMP Battery remains fully charged even when used[/p][/*][*][p][b]Extra Juice:[/b] Revives grant EMP Battery charge[/p][/*][*][p][b]Background Process:[/b] Adds passive EMP Battery charging that increases while sprinting[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kinetic Converter:[/b] Increases movement speed based on EMP Battery charge percentage[/p][/*][*][p][b]Heat Signature:[/b] Spend EMP Battery charge to highlight enemies through walls[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]ELITE HEMLOK[/b][/h2][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/7G54FAUdnbPUXfJ2ixMSEh/ae3c1cea8b8d25358b2f3aec864cd93b/APEX_Legends_S28_Screenshots_Elite_Hemlok.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.40286458333333336,yPosition=0.47962962962962963"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Full-auto Hemlok go brrrr. [/p][p align="start"]Tear through enemy defenses with the new Hemlok Breach AR: it’s packing full-auto fire, a Silencer and a Breach Launcher with new Breach Shot mode. It’s a lot. In the best way. [/p][p align="start"]Get all the details on this new breaching tool in the Patch Notes below.[/p][h2][b]EVENT ITEMS[/b][/h2][p][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/1GlAXLxyXhbie6d8IsvDyQ/5b56d46f6b4726218560a2417a4b0b4e/Aftershock_Legend_Skins_Blog_thumbnail.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Light up the Outlands with new Event cosmetics, check out the new Legend Skins for Wattson, Ash, Pathfinder, Horizon, Crypto, and Gibraltar.[/p][p][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/2LXbDumWONwMgE8JAXOFwJ/549455daf8e25adf1f0271beb278c981/Aftershock_Weapon_Skins_Blog_thumbnail.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Fresh new Weapon Skins are dropping too, including the EVA-8 “Hard Core”, the Havoc “Technoforged”, the CAR “Static Discharge” and more.[/p][p][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/4TpgCsVkK7m5XjwIimA9tA/05bf53321e7d83f77b71eaf7d124fc6f/Aftershock_Fuse-Prestige_Blog_thumbnail.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.534375,yPosition=0.5"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The future is Fuse, mate! The king of showboating gets a new Prestige Skin, complete with a custom Finisher and Dive Trail. He’s earned it.[/p][h2][b]REWARD SHOP[/b][/h2][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/4KiKxRx7MAialsXWaZPCW1/380cd50b7c1dd3489e526f34988e8e7d/Aftershock_Rewards_001.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.18567708333333333,yPosition=0.5509259259259259"][/img][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/40pZU3AHahz1gaWLMYBsBL/d7d0ee6ba9917637a823ac109b31db01/Aftershock_Rewards_002.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.17421875,yPosition=0.5203703703703704"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Head to the Reward Shop and exchange your Cells for two rotating sets of rewards, each available for a limited time. [/p][list][*][p][b]Mar 31 to Apr 10:[/b] Grab an Aftershock Pack, an Epic Lifeline Legend Skin, a Tracker Set, and more.[/p][/*][*][p][b]April 10 to Apr 21:[/b] Score an Aftershock Pack, an Epic Lifeline Banner Frame, and more.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]STORE TAB[/b][/h2][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/2KgFd7SXVD9OJaxrdRe8RS/3195b89e3383b716ed57881d419a023a/Aftershock_Store_Offers_v1.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Explore limited-time offers in the Aftershock Milestone Collection, available in the Store or as possible drops from Aftershock Packs from Mar 31 to May 5.[/p][h2][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h2][h3][b]AUDIO SYSTEMS CHANGES[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We are making a couple adjustments to in-match audio to align with our continued commitment to provide the most informative audio experience possible. [/p][list][*][p]In response to community feedback, we have lowered the volume of Hardlight mesh shattering. [/p][/*][*][p]As footstep audio acts as a primary means of tracking enemies who aren’t in front of you, we are increasing the volume of footsteps from enemies outside your POV - enemy footstep volume further increases as the source of the footsteps gets further behind you (ie. loud when beside you, louder when over your shoulder, even louder when directly behind you). We will continue to listen to player feedback and make impactful changes to polish the in-game experience for our community![/p][/*][/list][h3][b]LEGENDS[/b][/h3][p][b]GIBRALTAR[/b][/p][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: Your big bruddah has been sitting at the bottom of pick rate charts for a while now, so it was time to give him some love. With a new passive that will allow him to traverse and rotate quicker, some quality of life updates to his base kit and some meaningful upgrades to let you choose your playstyle. The Dome of Protection has become easier and easier to push these days so we wanted to give Gibraltar some better defenses and faster resets. We also wanted players to be able to upgrade into more versatility with his ultimate.[/i][/p][p][b]Passive[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New Passive - Momentum Boost[/b][/p][list][*][p]If Gibraltar maintains sprint speed for a couple of seconds he will get a speed boost. [/p][/*][*][p]This will only trigger while unarmed or if the weapon doesn’t have a sprint speed restriction (ex. The Fast Shotties Upgrade)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Gibraltar punch will deal double damage to Hardlight[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cooldown on Dome of Protection reduced (was 17s, now 13s)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Ultimate[/b][/p][list][*][p]Integrated the size increase upgrade into his base kit, increasing radius by 20%[/p][/*][*][p]Call in time for the missiles has been sped up[/p][/*][*][p]Can now throw your ultimate before the ultimate equip animation finishes[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Upgrades[/b][/p][list][*][p]Level 2[/p][list][*][p][b]Thunder Dome:[/b] The dome becomes electrified when placed, and will deal 50 damage and slow the first enemy to enter [/p][/*][*][p][b]Healing Dome:[/b] Dome duration increases 4s and any player within the healing dome will get double small meds healing[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Level 3[/p][list][*][p][b]Triple Bombardment:[/b] Splits the ultimate into 3 charges, reducing the radius and number of missiles for each[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Removed Big Bruddah, Bubble Bunker, Baby Bubble[/p][/*][/list][p][b]WRAITH[/b][/p][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: Wraith's pick rate popularity has been on a slow decline over the years; she’s starting to get overshadowed by other popular skirmishers. We wanted to address this by giving her some meaningful buffs to her base kit and by giving her some more interesting upgrade options that will provide more utility for her team.[/i][/p][p][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Integrated the tactical cooldown reduction upgrade into her base kit (was 20s, now 15s)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Ultimate[/b][/p][list][*][p]Integrated the ultimate cooldown reduction upgrade into her base kit (was 2.5 minutes, now 1.5 minutes)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased casting speed animation for quicker activation[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Upgrades[/b][/p][list][*][p]Level 2[/p][list][*][p][b]Phase Dome:[/b] When Wraith starts channeling her ultimate she will create a Phase Dome. This dome will last for 30s or until Wraith places her portal. Anyone who enters the Phase Dome will go into the void. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Level 3[/p][list][*][p][b]Phase Jumper:[/b] Wraith will stay in the void for longer when using her tactical (was 4s, now 6s) and will gain double jump while in the void[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]WATTSON[/b][/p][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: We wanted to give Wattson some unique ways to interact with Hardlight meshes and provide some quality of life updates to her kit.[/i][/p][p][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Placing a fence in front of a Hardlight mesh will reinforce it; if the mesh is broken the fence will rebuild and reinforce it[/p][/*][*][p]Increased fence damage (was 20, now 35)[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced fence deployment time (was 1s, now 0.5s)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Ultimate[/b][/p][list][*][p]When Wattson’s ultimate is placed it will reinforce Hardlight meshes in the zone of the pylon; if the mesh is broken it will rebuild and reinforce the mesh. [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]WEAPONS[/b][/h3][p][b]AR[/b][/p][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: Breach and Clear! The Hemlok is our latest entry of Elite Weapons. This powerhouse has a custom built barrel pre-attached that provides excellent recoil stabilization, a fully integrated silencer, and a brand new recharging Breach Charge that lets you tear down enemy structures or break into their reinforced bunkers.[/i][/p][p][b]Hemlok Breach AR \[Elite Weapon][/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed Burst & Single firing modes[/p][/*][*][p]New Firing Mode: Automatic[/p][list][*][p]Slow fire rate[/p][/*][*][p]Body Damage: 23[/p][/*][*][p]Headshot Damage: 32[/p][/*][*][p]Integrated Silencer[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Firing Mode: Breach Charge[/p][list][*][p]Single shot explosive[/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown: 15 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]Damage to players: 38 with radial falloff[/p][/*][*][p]Significant damage multiplier to Hardlight and structures[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]MARKSMAN[/b][/p][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: With our latest pass on Marksmans we were successful in bringing down the overall oppressiveness of our long ranged weapons but in the 30-30’s case we’ve dulled its fangs just a bit too much. So we’re giving back some of its base damage so it’s still a consistent and viable option without the incredible spikes those charged headshots can create.[/i][/p][p][b]30-30 Repeater[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased base damage to 43 (was 41)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]PISTOL[/b][/p][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: The RE-45 Burst was our first foray into the Elite Weapon system and we had always intended to swap back to the OG automatic light version of the weapon. However, in this case, we feel the energy burst version of the RE-45 is a compelling iteration that carves out a more ownable place in the weapon roster. Moving back to its light version only muddies the design space around the R-99, Alternator, and the rest of the light weapons. Moving forward the RE-45 will be a permanent energy weapon.[/i][/p][p][b]RE-45 Burst[/b][/p][list][*][p]Elite version is now the default version of the RE-45[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Elite weapon visual treatment[/p][/*][/list][p][b]P2020[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased points required to unlock Hammerpoints to 425 (was 500)[/p][/*][*][p]Base magazine size increased to 9 (was 8)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]SHOTGUN[/b][/p][p][b]EVA-8[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved base reload speed[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]SMG[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: When we added the automatic trigger to the Prowler we also increased the delay between bursts to keep its overall power in check since we were increasing its ease of use substantially. However, we didn’t see as big a draw to it as we expected so we’re giving it back some of its snappyness so it feels competitive in CQC.[/i][/p][p][b]Prowler PDW[/b][/p][list][*][p]Burst fire delay reduced[/p][/*][*][p]Recoil improvements[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]MAPS[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]Olympus[/b][/p][p align="start"]Moved Elysium to a new location on the northeast corner of the map near Rift. The purpose of this change is to eliminate the forced contest between Somers University and Elysium in Ranked and Competitive. We have modified the terrain in this area to support the change, which includes the removal of a minor POI previously in this location.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/4GIBY2AO9lvSNnQkK7H0zV/b5e40b9fc23a9a074ad845b17522010a/Map_Changes_-_Elysium.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.42291666666666666,yPosition=0.5458333333333333"][/img][/p][p][b]Pubs & Ranked[/b][/p][list][*][p]Olympus[/p][/*][*][p]Storm Point[/p][/*][*][p]World’s Edge[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Mixtape[/b][/p][list][*][p]March 24th, 2026 - May 5th, 2026[/p][list][*][p]TDM: Skull Town, Fragment, Estates[/p][/*][*][p]Control: Labs, Thunderdome, Lava Siphon[/p][/*][*][p]Gun Run: Monument, Skull Town, Thunderdome[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]WILDCARD[/b][/h3][p][b]Wildcard[/b][/p][list][*][p]March 31st, 2026 - Killing dummies in the firing range will now trigger all appropriate “on knock” behavior[/p][/*][*][p]Catalyst - Removed a dead spot for Piercing Spikes where enemies could sometimes stand near the center of it without taking damage[/p][/*][*][p]Catalyst - In the firing range with friendly fire on, Piercing Spikes will no longer activate because the owner got within range[/p][/*][*][p]Octane - Fixed issue where Stim Surge would remain in alt hand while using Akimbo[/p][/*][*][p]Fuse - Level 3 upgrade Reignition now works properly against dummies in the firing range[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Sparrow’s SWAT scout skin appearing bright red at long distances[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Newcastle wall destroying Mad Maggie's wrecking ball if deployed too closely[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed parts of Catalyst as well as Conduit's Heart Machine skin having visible portions while being revived by Mirage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where decals on Crypto's Destiny Gundam Spec II skin would remain visible while he was cloaked[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]QUALITY OF LIFE[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Cleaned up the iron sight on the 30-30’s “Long-Distance Agony” skin to align with its others[/p][/*][*][p]Can now use the double jump off Octane’s jump pad while healing[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Alternator SMG[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed the extra hit markers (usually reserved for blast patterns on shotguns) when in Double Tap mode[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: These extra hit markers were making it a little more difficult to track enemies than intended so we’ve removed them to declutter the reticle space and improve combat visibility when landing shots.[/i][/p][p][b]Vault Keys[/b][/p][list][*][p]Vault keys will no longer affect the colour of a deathbox[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][i]Dev Notes: Vault Keys can be an important piece of loot, but getting baited by a red box with the hopes of a Kraber to be dashed by a Vault Key can feel terrible. This change will retain their rarity but no longer let them drive a deathboxes rarity tier.[/i][/p][h3][b]APEX BOTS[/b][/h3][p align="start"]New In-Combat Healing System[/p][list][*][p]Apex Bots will attempt to find cover and heal when damaged during combat Use these moments to push![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]New Target Acquisition and Awareness System[/p][list][*][p]Apex Bots will make more intelligent decisions around which target to focus on. They'll be harder to sneak up on.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Improved Strafing[/p][list][*][p]Apex Bots can move toward their target while strafing, letting them close distance in a more aggressive way.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]New Weapon Switching System[/p][list][*][p]Apex Bots will switch weapons based on the distance from the target. Get too close, and if Apex Bots have a shotgun - watch out![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Improved Bot Traversal[/p][list][*][p]Apex Bots will utilize the various movement mechanics around the map like ziplines, ziprails, jump towers and more, to traverse and pursue.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]AUDIO[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the audio mix setting not saving properly on consoles[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered volume of Hardlight mesh breaking, as per community feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Increased volume of footsteps from enemies outside your field of view[/p][list][*][p]Volume further increases as the source of the footsteps gets further behind you (ie. loud when beside you, louder when over your shoulder, loudest when directly behind you)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]ENGINE[/b][/h3][list][*][p]PC: Apex now uses the Windows Audio Session API (WASAPI) for microphone input.[/p][list][*][p]This enables support in Windows 11 for the "Voice Clarity" audio enhancement, which you can enable to help remove unwanted background audio.[/p][list][*][p]The option can be found in Window settings. Go to "System > Sound > Mic Properties" and look for "Audio Enhancements" in "Input settings".[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Note: if you have multiple microphones connected to your PC & the game is using the wrong one you can either... [/p][list][*][p]Select a specific microphone in Apex's Audio settings in the Voice Chat settings, see "Voice Chat Input Device" option.[/p][/*][*][p]Or set your mic "as default for communications" in Windows settings and then use the System Default option in Apex's Voice Chat settings.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Graphics:[/p][list][*][p]Static objects now use bindless resources and batching to significantly reduce draw calls, improving baseline CPU performance for map rendering[/p][/*][*][p]Olympus uses improved algorithms to generate occlusion culling data structures, slightly improving CPU performance on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]PC: Uses ReBAR for faster uploads of data to the GPU, on systems that support it. This can reduce pop-in of models and textures and also use less time on the CPU, which can help performance stability.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Visual improvements:[/p][list][*][p]More accurate reflection intensity in dark areas[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the clarity of ambient occlusion and specular occlusion[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Apex Legends x Gundam Event
newsitems.author: Electronic Arts
newsitems.contents:
[h1]Apex Legends x Gundam Event[/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="d542OZEy6Lk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Gundam comes to the Outlands March 10.[/b]   [/p][p]Fight in the Gundam universe and wield iconic weapons like the Buster Rifle, unleash Gundam Wildcard abilities,  and fight on a Broken Moon filled with destroyed Mobile Suits and Gundam Wing statues.    Celebrate your love of the fandom (without getting a Gquuuuuux tattoo) with Legendary cosmetics, Gundam-inspired skins,  a Limited Edition Gunpla drop, and more. [/p][h2]Wildcard: Gundam Takeover[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/3b9292b01fbeac7a83607c70636323f6d5b8cee0.png"][/img][/p][p]Drop into Wildcard and earn your wings. Broken Moon transforms into a full Gundam battlefield for the event,  with destroyed Mobile Suits scattered across the terrain, massive climbable Wing Gundam statues, and ships battling overhead.   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/a135633c0ce25526de17d5fa1a8a54ae7fbfe057.png"][/img][/p][p]Grab the Buster Rifle from Care Packages and launch skyward for aerial recon, scan through walls to mark every enemy,  and fire laser beams that cut through cover and explode on impact.    [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/6bb2c0299e7fa196e90c3fc4a8bfd13275b2fc44.png"][/img][/p][p]Use Bit Staves as shields to absorb damage while you push, or switch to Drone Command and send them out to patrol,  scan, and attack anyone who dares trespass in your territory.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/dec1d2bf3cb0b0209755f9211a12e697cb54eaf9.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Unleash lethal Gundam abilities with new Wild Cards, including:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Epyon's Lash:[/b] Adds a magnetic melee pull Tactical ability, and more.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Heavyarms Salvo:[/b] Marks enemies for air support missile strikes after landing multiple hits.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zero Sacrifice:[/b] Adds the option to trigger a self-destruct explosion on knock, taking nearby enemies with you.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zero Rebirth:[/b] Enter the Void when knocked, then exit with 1 HP, temporary invulnerability and health regen.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Event Items[/h2][p] We thought long and hard about which Legends were the right fit for each Mobile Suit. And after only a few dozen hours  of fierce debate and a rewatch of original VHS tapes (subbed obviously), we set to work.  [b]We’ve got Gundam-inspired skins for 8 Legends, each one tailored to the Legend’s personality, playstyle, and lore:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Alter:[/b] Gundam Epyon[/p][/*][*][p][b]Conduit:[/b] Gundam Aerial[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crypto:[/b] Freedom Gundam[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gibby:[/b] Xi Gundam[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mirage:[/b] Destiny Gundam Spec II[/p][/*][*][p][b]Octane:[/b] GQuuuuuux[/p][/*][*][p][b]Revenant:[/b] Gundam Deathscythe Hell[/p][/*][*][p][b]Valkyrie:[/b] Wing Gundam Zero[/p][/*][/list][p]Plus, a Char Aznable-inspired Sparrow Skin available in the Reward Shop.   [/p][p]You want more, huh? How about a Buster Rifle? Check out 8 stunning new Gundam-themed weapon skins, including the  “Buster Rifle” Kraber, the “Destiny 99” R-99, and the “Aerial 301” R-301.  [b]Two Gundam-inspired Mythics are also available during the Event:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Epyon Heat Rod[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Beam Saber[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The Epyon Heat Rod is available as a possible drop in Gundam Heat Rod Event Packs, while the Beam Saber is available  as a possible drop in Gundam Beam Saber Event Packs. [/p][h2]Reward Shop[/h2][p]Earn Medals during the Event to unlock items from the Reward Shop, including an Epic Char Aznable-inspired Sparrow skin,  plus a Gundam-themed Banner Frame, Trackers, and Sticker. [/p][h2]Apex Legends x Gundam Store[/h2][p]Hit up the limited-time Apex Legends x Gundam Event Store to directly purchase any Legend Skins from the Event until  [b]April 14[/b].
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/6dd1d8250da6340fabd6e81a4c8deba9e25b596a.png"][/img][/p][h2]Limited-Edition Gunpla Drop[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/1f2915cff7cff6247fc8cf17ded267dbdbe71e24.png"][/img][/h2][p]Ready for a little merch drop? To celebrate the Apex Legends x Gundam Event out of game, BANDAI NAMCO is releasing  3 limited-edition Apex Legends-inspired Model Kits (GUNPLA) for sale: [/p][list][*][p]RG 1/144 FREEDOM GUNDAM -APEX LEGENDS™ Crypto Ver-[/p][/*][*][p]RG 1/144 WING GUNDAM ZERO EW -APEX LEGENDS™ Valkyrie Ver-[/p][/*][*][p]RG 1/144 GUNDAM EPYON -APEX LEGENDS™ Alter Ver-[/p][/*][/list][p]Each kit will be available for pre-order online from [b]March 18[/b] while supplies last.  Offers may vary or change; visit the Apex Legends Shop or PREMIUM BANDAI for more details.[/p][h2]New to Gundam?[/h2][p]There’s never been a better time to dive into one of the most influential mech-driven, character-focused universes ever created.  From the iconic anime and model kits (GUNPLA) to video games, trading card games, and new film releases, Gundam continues to evolve.  Explore the Gundam universe on the official Gundam site, or check out the official Gundam YouTube Channel. [/p][h2]Patch Notes: Recent Updates & Fixes[/h2][p]Here are some updates and fixes from our most recent patches:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an edge case crash impacting Trios and Duos[/p][/*][*][p]Server stability improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a hole where players were able to fall through on Broken Moon in BR and Wildcard[/p][/*][*][p]Completing Road to Ranked Challenges now correctly unlock Ranked[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a situation where players would lose access to main tabs on home screens or their currencies would display incorrectly[/p][/*][*][p]"Riptide Predator" Peacekeeper Skin draw speed now matches all other weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Choosing a controller perk now grants that Legend the ability to reinforce Hardlight as intended[/p][/*][*][p]Players will no longer spawn over water in Wildcard[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Ranked lobbies to provide either a Dropship or Drop Zone experiences based on that lobby's players' rank composition[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Drop Zones rules:[/b][/p][list][*][p]All matches with 10+ Diamond players OR 1+ Master/Predator player will have Drop Zones[/p][/*][*][p]    Players may experience a mixture of Dropship and Drop Zone matches, particularly for Platinum players or those squadding up    with Diamond+ players, as we work out the thresholds  [/p][/*][*][p]If your pending lobby will have Drop Zones you will see “RANKED - DROP ZONES” displayed on the match loading screen[/p][/*][*][p]    When loading into a Drop Zones match, the Rank Tier Display will show each player's individual Rank Tier    (Dropship matches will keep the current 'Squad' version of the Rank Tier Distribution)  [/p][/*][/list][h2]On Our Radar[/h2][p]Here’s a couple of the open issues that we’ve seen some community chatter around that are currently being worked on.  Stay up to date with our progress on these issues and more on our public Trello board. [/p][list][*][p]When using a controller, there is an issue where some Legends cannot activate their ultimate while their tactical is available[/p][/*][/list][h2]Use Your Head, Earn Your Wings[/h2][p][b]Join the endless waltz: the Apex Legends x Gundam Event drops March 10.[/b]   [/p][p]Play Apex Legends™ for free* now on PlayStation®4, PlayStation®5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch™, Nintendo Switch™ 2  and PC via the EA app, Epic, and Steam.    [/p][p]Follow Apex Legends™ on X, Instagram, TikTok, subscribe to our YouTube channel, and check out our forums.    [/p][p]Sign up for our newsletter today to receive the latest Apex Legends™ news, updates, behind-the-scenes content, exclusive offers,  and more (including other EA news, products, events, and promotions) by email.    [/p][p]This announcement may change as we listen to community feedback and continue developing and evolving our Live Service & Content.  We will always strive to keep our community as informed as possible. For more information, please refer to EA’s Online Service Updates at  [url="https://www.ea.com/service-updates"]https://www.ea.com/service-updates[/url].    [/p][p]*Applicable platform account and platform subscription (sold separately) may be required. A persistent internet connection and EA account required.    Age restrictions apply. Includes in-game purchases.  †Not available in all territories.[/p]

newsitems.title: Apex Legends: Game Stability Update - 2/26/2026
newsitems.author: respawn_bean
newsitems.contents:
[p]With the launch of Season 28, our team made changes that resulted in a significantly more stable, performant Apex Legends experience for our community - specifically, in instances where players would encounter FPS drops or their match would feel like it was running in slow motion.
[/p][p]After thorough investigation, we discovered the root cause of a server bottleneck. Our cloud infrastructure works by having multiple game servers running on each AWS machine. In some cases, the CPUs for these machines were hitting 100% usage and resulted in players experiencing performance drops and slowmo servers.[/p][p][/p][p]Our team implemented numerous server performance optimizations and, as a result, we have seen a substantial drop in instances of matches with these issues. We are happy to report: players are experiencing more stable matches!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/7a038d0af4937113a02b5467262445bf50b6d252.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The above graph displays CPU usage for Ranked servers (the mode where we saw the most instances of slomo) - you can clearly see a drop with the 28.0 launch on 2/10 10:00 PT. The minor fluctuation you see just after 16:00 PT was caused by a small server update we deployed at that time[/p][p][/p][p]As always, we will continue to closely monitor and look for more opportunities to improve game stability.[/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: An Update from the Anti Cheat Team - 02/25/2026
newsitems.author: respawn_bean
newsitems.contents:
[p][b]Valkyrie “Wallhack” Exploit[/b][b]
 [/b]We recently resolved an exploit involving Valkyrie’s Ultimate ability that allowed players to improperly retain enemy highlight information outside of its intended activation window. Under specific conditions involving map vehicles, the interaction could place the ability into an unintended state, granting persistent visibility benefits to the player and their squad.
[/p][p]Once identified, our team reproduced the issue, isolated the underlying state-handling error, and deployed a fix to prevent the interaction from occurring. The exploit is now fully mitigated.
[/p][p]We want to be clear: intentionally abusing in-game bugs to gain a competitive advantage [url="https://tos.ea.com/legalapp/webterms/us/en/pc/#section6"][u]violates our rules[/u][/url]. Accounts confirmed to have deliberately exploited this issue received multi-week suspensions and Ranked Point removals. Competitive integrity—especially in ranked play—is something we actively monitor and enforce.
[/p][p]We also want to address content creation around active exploits. Publishing or promoting “how-to” videos that demonstrate game-breaking behavior—regardless of intent—amplifies the damage by accelerating its spread. If you discover a vulnerability, the responsible path is to report it directly to us through [url="https://forums.ea.com/category/apex-legends-en/ideas/apex-legends-bug-reports-en"][u]official channels[/u][/url]. Creating instructional content around active exploits will be treated as participation in the exploit itself. Moving forward, we may take enforcement action against both accounts abusing the issue in-game and content that promotes it.
[/p][p]We appreciate players who report issues responsibly and help us protect fair play. Our commitment remains the same: rapid response, firm enforcement, and ongoing improvements to ensure Apex Legends remains competitive and fair for everyone. [/p][p]
[/p]

[p]The update to Ranked lobbies hybridizing Dropship and Drop Zones is now live. Here are all the details you need to know:[/p][p align="start"][b]ADJUSTED[/b]
-All matches with 10+ Diamond players OR 1+ Master/Predator player will have Drop Zones
-Players may experience a mixture of Dropship and Drop Zone matches, particularly for Platinum players or those squadding up with Diamond+ players, as we work out the thresholds
-If your pending lobby will have Drop Zones you will see “RANKED - DROP ZONES” displayed on the match loading screen
-When loading into a Drop Zones match, the Rank Tier Display will show each player's individual Rank Tier (Dropship matches will keep the current 'Squad' version of the Rank Tier Distribution)
-Players in Masters will need to go back to the lobby and matchmake in order to requeue. We are working on a fix that will allow players to requeue as normal and will let you know when it is live[/p][p align="start"]This change is now live, and we will be closely monitoring the impact on competitive integrity and matchmaking health.

[b][i]Update as of 2/17/26 at 5:57pm PT: Players in Masters will now be able to requeue as normal.[/i][/b][/p]

newsitems.title: An Update from the Anti Cheat Team
newsitems.author: respawn_bean
newsitems.contents: [p]There was a claim that a player was banned for using a specific mouse. This is categorically false and not accurate. A player behavior detection compounded with other heuristics that accumulated over several months caused the user to meet the threshold for a ban. As per our normal process, we reviewed the ban and deemed it a false positive and unbanned the user. We have modified the rule that triggered the ban threshold and are currently looking at historical data for any other false positives now. If this specific mouse was being targeted for bans, you would see this issue across other titles as well that use EAC.[/p]

newsitems.title: Developer Update: Wildcard
newsitems.author: RSPN_karlee
newsitems.contents:
[p]We have heard your feedback, loud and clear, regarding our recent changes to Wildcard’s respawn system. As a result [b]we will be reverting these changes[/b] to more align with the Wildcard experience you know and love. 
[/p][p]We initially made these changes because match data indicated that high-death frequency in Wildcard matches may be contributing to player fatigue resulting in them leaving the mode. We were hoping to see if shaking up playstyles would help alleviate this potential concern. 
[/p][p]It’s also worth noting that some players experienced a bug where they were respawned off the map. This was never the intention. We have identified and squashed this bug, and the fix will go live with the other changes. 
[/p][p]As we roll this back, we’ll continue to monitor feedback and internal data. In the future, we will be sure to give you a heads up and provide more ample context and insight for [i]why [/i]we’re making changes. Ultimately, we want to make sure Wildcard is as fun for you as it is for us![/p][p]
This change is live [b]now[/b]! Thank you for your patience.[/p]

newsitems.title: Apex Legends: The Road Ahead
newsitems.author: respawn_bean
newsitems.contents:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="72G5kBBQzP4;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]WELCOME TO THE YEAR AHEAD IN APEX LEGENDS[/h2][p]With Apex Legends’ Anniversary in full-swing, it feels like an excellent opportunity to give you all a lay of the land for what the dev team is cooking up for the year ahead. We want to tell you all about the team’s design philosophy, the goals we’re setting for ourselves and, most excitingly, what content you have to look forward to.[/p][p]As you read on, please know: we are going to aim to be as thorough as possible, but we will be treating our roadmap like a living plan and we’ll have more surprises to share throughout the year. As an important disclaimer, game development timelines may shift throughout the year. When looking at “The Road Ahead” infographic, note that “Locked” content carries the most concrete timeline, “In Progress” denotes that the features are being actively worked on, and “Planned” content is in preproduction, with work to start soon. If we make changes to the projected timeline, we’ll do our best to communicate what’s changed and why.[/p][p][/p][h2]DESIGN PHILOSOPHY[/h2][p]Let’s dive right in with a bit of an overview about [i]how[/i] we want to push Apex Legends in 2026. First and most important, we are pushing forward with our Community-Focused development process. This isn’t new for our team as we continue to ensure that we’re taking player feedback into consideration with every decision. This means using community sentiment, data driven processes, and years of Apex game design experience to balance our decision making processes.[/p][p]Another key component this year is a continued commitment to transparent and forthcoming communications. We’ll maintain and strive to strengthen an open dialogue with the broader community, proactively sharing what’s changing and why, so you’re always in the loop and part of what we’re making. For the latest in updates and dev insights, check out the newly formed ApexLiveComms [u][url="https://x.com/apexlivecomms"]X[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://www.threads.com/@apexlivecomms"]Threads[/url][/u] accounts. [/p][p][/p][h2]2026 ROADMAP[/h2][p]Our goal for 2026 is simple: continue to evolve Apex Legends, the best, most competitive Battle Royale out there. Competition for all that’s fast, fair, and always evolving with you.[/p][p]We are continuing our focus on competition and ensuring it has depth for mastery and, at the same time, remain inviting for everyone to join in. It doesn’t matter if you’re a day-one grinder or just getting started… If you want to be the best, Apex Legends is going to be the place to prove it.[/p][p]With that in mind, we’re excited to share our content roadmap to give you a look at what’s coming in 2026 and beyond. We'll keep updating this all year long.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/8d45a73310a43dfbb68d0fe94759ea8134c7b0ed.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]ALWAYS ON UPDATES[/b][/p][p]Throughout 2026 and beyond, our team will be focused on implementing quality of life improvements, Legend balance changes, and tweaks to our audio systems to improve the overall, day-to-day player experience. This means, you’ll consistently feel the impact of our team’s quick work in frequent tweaks, adjustments, and updates.[/p][p]We will also continue our commitment to competitive integrity, dedicated to maintaining and raising the bar on our anti-cheat, matchmaking and server performance.[/p][p][b]LEGENDS[/b][/p][p]Legends are the lifeblood of Apex Legends (it’s right there in the game’s title) so we are introducing TWO new Legends - a Skirmisher Legend in Season 29 and another in Season 32. Both new Legends are designed to shake up how you approach building your squad by providing new ways to take on fights together. [/p][p]We will also continue to evolve our existing roster with Legend Reworks planned for Seasons 30 and 31. Currently planned in Season 32, along with the new Legend, we will be updating team comp by overhauling the Legend Class system.[/p][p][b]WILDCARD[/b][/p][p]Wildcard was a groundbreaking addition to Apex Legends in 2025, creating an often-chaotic, heartpumping experience, and allowing for frequent experimentation (looking at you, hoverboards). In 2026 we are committing to events in Wildcard every season, with Season 30 and beyond boasting two Wildcard events each, one per split. Keep an eye on the near horizon as we’ll be featuring a pair of special events (we can’t say more now, but holy heck are we pumped for these!)[/p][p][b]MAPS[/b][/p][p]In the first half of the year, we will be working on POI updates, balancing cover placement, and rotational flow focused on improving how they feel to play at all levels of competition. Later in the year, you can expect a competitive update for World’s Edge and a major map update that is sure to shake things up, and bring a little dose of nostalgia to our seasoned players.[/p][p][b]LOOT[/b][/p][p]In Season 28 we shifted the loot pool to make finding desirable items in-match easier by removing Backpacks and Knockdown Shields and tying them into your base kit. Currently slated to land in Season 30, we are overhauling the in-match looting experience. We’re taking aim at making power progression more impactful and streamlined in every single match you play. Furthermore, we will be introducing a new way to wield an existing fan favourite weapon in Season 31![/p][p][b]GAME INTEGRITY[/b][/p][p]We are shooting for best-in-class online integrity, continuing to crack down on cheaters and improve how we keep bad actors out of the Apex Games. We know we have our work cut out for us, but we’re dedicated to the task. [/p][p]RAPID RESPONSE TIMES[/p][p]Rapid responses and game changes from the dev team will be a key part of our playbook as we continue to pay close attention to your moment-to-moment experiences, feedback, and data. Quality of Life updates will continue to roll in during every season. From bug fixes to meta adjustments, you won’t need to wait for the next major update for what matters the most. [/p][p][/p][h2]REFLECTING ON 2025[/h2][p]While looking ahead to all that’s projected for 2026 and beyond, we wanted to take a moment to thank you and look at the most exciting things you helped us shape in 2025. [/p][p]In 2025, we:[/p][list][*][p]added all-new content and meta changes all year long[/p][/*][*][p]released our newest Legend, Sparrow[/p][/*][*][p]launched Wildcard[/p][/*][*][p]revamped Olympus and E-District maps[/p][/*][*][p]made major changes across our weapons and Legends rosters[/p][/*][*][p]migrated the game to new servers for more stability and responsive online play[/p][/*][*][p]meaningfully added to our Audio systems, allowing for better threat detection and fairer games with less audio clutter[/p][/*][/list][p]Also in 2025, we took some big swings at tuning matchmaking and fighting cheaters. We know fighting cheating is a never-ending battle and even a small number of bad actors can impact match quality. These improvements are signals we’re heading in the right direction to keep more cheaters out of the game overall, and that we’re catching more of them earlier than before. We know there's more to do in this area in 2026, so expect ongoing updates. [/p][p][/p][p]Let’s take a quick look at some highlights that capture the hard work of the Anti-Cheat team:[/p][list][*][p]~50,000 cheat preventions per day[/p][list][*][p]Our team strengthened EAC client-integrity checks to detect manipulated clients [i]before[/i] cheaters enter matches[/p][/*][*][p]As a result, players made fewer reports and encountered fewer cheaters as we stopped them earlier in the funnel[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]>86,600,000 RP removed from cheaters in 2025[/p][list][*][p]Resulting in honest players climbing higher on the leaderboards[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Shipped gameplay driven cheat detection models[/p][list][*][p]Models are used to identify anomalous gameplay patterns without relying on client signatures[/p][/*][*][p]Bot and Teaming detection fully automated and moved into production pipelines[/p][/*][*][p]Aimbot detection models still in validation/testing stage[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]The following are year-over-year comparisons from 2024 to 2025.[/p][list][*][p]Ranked match infection rate on PC is down ~33% [/p][/*][*][p]Our new Teaming detection model resulted in a 300% increase in bans for Teaming[/p][/*][*][p]Bot bans are down 38%, implying there are fewer active bot accounts in the Apex games[/p][/*][*][p]Reports Per User (RPU) is down for Teaming and Botting, 62% and 58% respectively, meaning players are encountering these issues less than a year ago (Data is aggregated across PC and Console)[/p][/*][*][p]Overall RPU's are down 22% (Also, aggregated across PC and Console)[/p][/*][/list][h2]CONCLUSION[/h2][p]2025 was an incredibly exciting time for Apex Legends and we are delighted to carry that momentum into 2026. Thank you to everyone who has been along for the ride; whether you joined us in 2025, or you’ve been with us from the beginning (or somewhere in between), you are the reason we continue to strive to make Apex Legends the best, most competitive Battle Royale out there. We are [i]thrilled[/i] for you all to experience what we have been working on and we’ll see you on the Dropship![/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: Developer Follow-up: Dropships in Ranked
newsitems.author: RSPN_karlee
newsitems.contents:
[p]Thank you for your continued feedback on the readdition of Dropships in Ranked. We hear you, and we are continuing to monitor conversations in community spaces and official channels.[/p][p][/p][p]We wanted to add context to - and elaborate further on - our decision to add Dropships back to Ranked matches. 
[/p][p]When making a decision of this magnitude, one we know will impact a substantial portion of the community, we consider input from a number of different sources. Chief among them are: playtests, surveys and feedback from our players globally, and live game data. With the initial implementation of Drop Zones for Ranked, early feedback sparked polarizing discussions that became more critical over time, especially in certain regions. 
[/p][p]In Season 26, our data indicated a noteworthy decline in Ranked population with the implementation of controlled Drop Zones. 
[/p][p]In Season 27, we addressed top player frustrations surrounding loot distribution across POIs and scoring, but did not see a meaningful impact on the declining Ranked population data. After the results of Seasons 26 and 27, we decided to revert the Drop Zones, aiming to keep Ranked populations healthy and strong to ensure faster and fairer matchmaking for all.[/p][p][/p][p]We know it’s early, but since the launch of Season 28 we have seen encouraging data to suggest more players on their Ranked journey and more matches being played, resulting in a more healthy game experience. We know stats don’t fully capture how matches feel and play out. We’re actively monitoring gameplay and testing potential adjustments based on what we’re seeing in the game and hearing from you. [/p][p][/p][p]One of the biggest challenges for our team is to balance conflicting needs in a substantial global player base. In some situations, the needs of one subset of players may directly contradict the desires of another. It is rare that one solution appeases the entire playerbase. While it’s a difficult feat, we are dedicated to making choices to ensure the long term health of the game and playerbase. [/p][p][/p][p]We will continue to monitor this topic, and we will return with another update next week.[/p]

newsitems.title: An Update from the Anti Cheat Team
newsitems.author: respawn_bean
newsitems.contents:
[h2][b]Security Clarification: Competitive Integrity and Recent Incidents[/b][/h2][p]We wanted to provide some additional details around two recent security-related situations that generated questions within the community. In both cases, our priority was to protect competitive integrity, ensure a secure environment, and act decisively to prevent abuse.
[/p][p][b]Controller Hardware at the [url="https://algs.ea.com/en"][u]ALGS[/u][/url] Year 5 Championship
[/b]During routine inspection ahead of the ALGS Year 5 Championship, [url="https://esportsinsider.com/2026/01/imperialhal-controller-banned-for-algs-year-5-championship"][u]a third-party controller was identified that included functionality not permitted in professional play.[/u][/url] Testing revealed the presence of programmable inputs and wireless configuration features that posed both a competitive fairness concern and a potential risk to the secure LAN environment. Because these features could be modified externally through a phone based app and during live gameplay, the device was immediately removed from competition prior to the start of the event.
[/p][p]Working directly with the League Operations team and following extensive testing, the device was later allowed back into use only after an unreleased firmware update fully removed all non-compliant functionality and disabled external connectivity. Even then, its use was permitted under strict monitoring for the remainder of the tournament. It’s important to note that consumer versions of this device remain non-compliant and should be used at users own risk at home. 
[/p][p][b]Server Stability Issues Caused by Player Name Format[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/86d063b62acdde3646bd50e024b50efe3478afc3.png"][/img][/p][p]Separately, we investigated reports suggesting that Ranked matches were being DDoSed by a set of users using an extremely long name. This characterization was inaccurate and not, in fact, a DDoS attack. The issue stemmed from a validation edge case where excessively long player names could trigger a scripting error, resulting in a match disconnect under specific circumstances. While disruptive, this was not a network attack and did not involve external traffic or infrastructure abuse.
[/p][p]The underlying issue has been addressed by tightening validation limits to ensure player names are safely handled in all gameplay scenarios. This fix prevents the behavior entirely and removes the ability for malicious actors to exploit name formatting to disrupt matches.
[/p][p]We take both security and competitive fairness extremely seriously. These incidents reinforced the importance of proactive testing, rapid response, and clear enforcement of our rules and standards. We’ll continue auditing systems, validating hardware, and addressing edge cases to ensure Apex Legends remains fair, stable, and secure for all players—from Ranked matches to the highest levels of competition.[/p][p]
[/p]
